text: もう どうでもいいんだよ 全部!
translation: I don't care anymore about any of it!

vocabulary.meaning: already, anymore, now (indicates change or finality)
doesn't matter, don't care (expression showing indifference)

grammar: んだよ is an explanatory/emphatic ending (の+だ casual form). The よ particle adds emphasis to the emotional statement.
